definitions.cleared_minor: Net funds older than clearing_window_days (time eligible).
definitions.pending_minor: Net of newer items (including late chargebacks/refunds) not yet cleared.

requirements: Any mutation to cleared_minor or pending_minor MUST recompute total_minor and available_minor in the same transaction.
available_minor MUST never exceed total_minor (liability cap).

p0.text: Running payout computation for the same (org_id, provider_account_ref) concurrently in multiple workers. Use OBQC serialized queues.
Trusting provider_account_ref from incoming payload instead of deriving it from verified webhook credentials (PAY-1).
Emitting payout-finalization events outside the same transaction that commits the ledger postings/outbox record (non-atomic outbox).

rules.text: IdempotencyRecord MUST be enforced via a DB unique constraint (org_id, operation, key). Replays with different request_hash MUST return ERR_CONFLICT with subcode LOCKS_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE.
If an OrgPayoutPolicy exists for org_id, clearing_window_days MUST be explicitly configured. If no OrgPayoutPolicy exists, effective clearing_window_days MUST default to 3 (days).
payout_freeze_enabled MUST block transitions to EXECUTING and MUST be re-checked by inquiry/finalization before marking PAID.

blocked_reason_subcode.description: If payout is blocked, indicates the primary ERR-1 reason_subcode used for denial/hold.

provider_account_ref.notes: Provider account reference derived from verified webhook credentials (PAY-1); MUST NOT be trusted from payload.

uniqueness_constraints.notes: Prevents duplicate provider payouts across accounts; provider_account_ref is mandatory scope.

PayoutBlocker.description: Auditable payout blocker used to fail-closed on enterprise risk flags (e.g., active disputes) and on explicit administrative holds.
invariants: PayoutBlocker records MUST be auditable. Creation is append-only; release marks released_at_utc but MUST NOT delete history.
blocker_kind=dispute_active MUST be created by system on pay.dispute_risk_flag_changed active=true for the relevant scope.
Automated authorities MUST NOT create manual_hold blockers; only explicit admin actions may do so.

provider_account_ref.notes: Provider account reference derived from verified webhook credentials (PAY-1); MUST NOT be trusted from payload.

rules.text: ProviderSettlementEvent MUST be append-only and deduplicated by (org_id, provider, provider_event_id) and/or dedupe_key.
ReconciliationRun MUST be immutable after completion; status transitions allowed only running->succeeded|failed.
Payout release MUST be gated on the latest completed ReconciliationRun status == succeeded (MATCHED) for (org_id, currency) as defined in invariants.reconciliation.
SettlementLineItem records MUST be append-only; updates are forbidden. Corrections MUST be expressed as additional line items or ledger postings.

provider_account_ref.notes: Provider account reference derived from verified webhook credentials (PAY-1); MUST NOT be trusted from payload.

rules.text: SettlementStatement MUST be immutable after creation except for version increment on canonicalization metadata additions that do not alter payload_sha256.
payload_sha256 MUST be computed over the exact persisted payload bytes; payload_storage_ref MUST point to an immutable blob (no overwrite).
available_minor MUST NOT be negative.
Reserve/release operations MUST be concurrency safe and MUST NOT use check-then-act reads.
cleared_minor MUST represent funds eligible by time (occurred_at_utc < now()-clearing_window_days).
total_minor MUST equal cleared_minor + pending_minor.
available_minor MUST equal min(total_minor, cleared_minor) (liability cap).
A TreasuryReservation MUST be created before a Payout may transition to EXECUTING.

Reservation create MUST atomically decrement TreasuryBalance.cleared_minor (and adjust available_minor as a DB-derived value) with predicate cleared_minor >= amount_minor AND (cleared_minor + pending_minor) >= amount_minor (liability cap). If available_minor is used, it MUST be a DB-generated column computed from authoritative components.
If payout transitions to FAILED (non-ambiguous) before provider submission, reservation MUST be RELEASED and TreasuryBalance MUST be credited back atomically in the same transaction.
If payout transitions to PAID, reservation MUST be CONSUMED atomically (no further releases).

DP-1.why: Route heavy payout computations to background bulkhead to protect checkout/payment pools.

EVT-1.why: All emitted payout events must be registered + governed.

LOCKS-1.why: Ban split-connection lock/write; use xact-scoped locks inside same Repo.transaction.

OBQC-1.why: Payout compute/execution must be serialized per (provider, provider_account_ref, org_id).

PAY-1.why: provider_account_ref must be derived from verified secret/headers, not payload.

PAY-3.why: Variance and dispute policy alignment for payout release/holds.

SM-0.why: Payout finalize and idempotent retries must be fenced (CAS token).

behavior: If active=true, create or ensure an open PayoutBlocker(kind=dispute_active) for the relevant scope with reason_subcode PAY_PAYOUT_BLOCKED_DISPUTE_ACTIVE.
If active=false and no other risk blockers remain, release the dispute_active blocker (set released_at_utc and release_reason_subcode).

p0.text: Advisory locks guarding payout mutations MUST be acquired and held in the same DB session/transaction as the protected write (LOCKS-1 session affinity).
Payout computation and execution MUST be serialized per (org_id, provider, provider_account_ref) using OBQC-1 serialized queues to prevent parallel balance calculation or double release.

Provider settlement identities MUST use the triple-key: provider + provider_account_ref + provider_event_id/provider_statement_id. provider_account_ref MUST be derived from verified credentials (PAY-1), never trusted from payload.
Finalize/release operations MUST be fenced (SM-0 CAS token) and idempotent under retries to prevent double payout.

invariants.payout_hold_conditions: Payout eligibility MUST be blocked when any of the following exist within the settlement scope: unresolved dispute/chargeback, unresolved offline provisional scans, or RefundRequest in manual_review status.
invariants.reconciliation_scope: Reconciliation MUST be scoped by org_id, payment_provider, provider_account_id, settlement_currency, and settlement_period. Payouts MUST NOT aggregate across providers, provider accounts, or currencies.

governance.notes: All payout/settlement events emitted by PAY-4 MUST be registered in EVT-1 with required_data_keys; schema drift is treated as P0.

Per-tenant per-currency treasury balances split into cleared, pending, and total with liability-capped availability.
Atomic treasury reservations for payouts (reserve/release/consume lifecycle).
Payout request lifecycle, execution orchestration, and bounded ambiguity inquiry loop.
Reconciliation gating for payout release (MATCHED required; MISMATCHED blocks).

rules.text: TreasuryBalance.available_minor MUST be liability-capped: available_minor MUST equal min(total_minor, cleared_minor) and MUST NOT exceed total_minor.
Ambiguity inquiry MUST be bounded: after ttl_hours_max or max_attempts, payout MUST transition to MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED and MUST stop polling.
If payout transitions to FAILED before provider submission, TreasuryReservation MUST be RELEASED and TreasuryBalance MUST be credited back atomically in the same transaction.
All UTC timestamps MUST be utc_datetime_usec: RFC3339 with mandatory trailing 'Z' and exactly 6 fractional digits (microseconds). No generic date-time formats are permitted.
All identifiers MUST be enforced as schema-constrained UUIDv7. org_id MUST be bare uuid_v7; all internal IDs MUST be lowercase <prefix> + uuid_v7 (see data_model.identifiers.id_prefixes).

TreasuryBalance MUST be a recomputable projection derived from LED-1 postings and immutable settlement line items; it MUST NOT be manually mutated outside defined Ash actions (reserve/release/consume/recompute). Any correction MUST be expressed via LED-1 postings and/or append-only adjustment records, never direct edits.
Atomic reservation UPDATE predicate Ash 3.x

rules.rationale: Enterprise-safe posture: avoid paying out funds while liability is disputed; prevents chargeback arbitrage and reduces settlement risk.
rules.text: While any active_dispute_risk flag exists for an org/provider_account/order (per PAY-3), PAY-4 MUST fail-closed: it MUST NOT execute payouts and MUST NOT release reserves/clearing outflows unless an explicit PAY-3 DisputeRiskOverride exists for scope payout_execute.

rules.rationale: Makes payout stops auditable and explainable in support and finance operations.
rules.text: Payout blocks MUST be represented as PayoutBlocker records with ERR-1 reason_subcode and authority. Blockers MUST be released explicitly (released_at_utc set) and history MUST be retained.

summary: Governs provider settlement ingestion, reconciliation, treasury availability, and payout orchestration with atomic reservations, liability-capped clearing (available=min(total,cleared)), bounded ambiguity inquiry, and strict multi-tenant isolation.

All reads/writes MUST fail closed when tenant context is missing.
Cross-tenant reads MUST be hidden as ERR_NOT_FOUND, not filtered silently.
